resourceDescriptors.description: An API request, such as a call to a Google Cloud service.

labels.description: The identifier of the GCP project associated with this resource, such as "my-project".
The service name as used for authentication, e.g. "compute.googleapis.com".
The location of the API request, e.g. "us-east1".

resourceDescriptors.description: A relational database hosted by Google Cloud SQL.

labels.description: The identifier of the GCP project associated with this resource.
The name of the Cloud SQL database.
The region in which the database is running, e.g. "us-central1".

resourceDescriptors.description: A cluster running in Google Cloud Dataproc.

labels.description: The identifier of the GCP project associated with this resource.
The region in which the cluster is running, e.g. "us-central1".

resourceDescriptors.description: A virtual machine instance running in Google Compute Engine.

labels.description: The identifier of the GCP project associated with this resource.
The numeric VM instance identifier assigned by Compute Engine.
The Compute Engine zone in which the VM is running, e.g. "us-central1-a".

resourceDescriptors.description: A bucket in Google Cloud Storage.

labels.description: The identifier of the GCP project associated with this resource.
The location of the bucket, e.g. "us-central1" or "US".
